analysis.calibration: the A/A twin's paired interval must lie inside +-$50, or every larger-than-$50 reading is reported as uncalibrated

contrasts.B1_B3: each model less inspect_then_sign; beats the baseline when the lower end of its 1 - 0.05/3 interval is above $0
contrasts.G1_G3: each model less the best-informed tenant; intervals, no test
contrasts.P1_P3: every pair of models; Holm over the three; claimed when Holm rejects 0; larger than $50 only when the 95% interval clears $50
contrasts.R1_R3: each model less inspect_lowball; 95% and 1 - 0.05/3 intervals, no test, beside B1 to B3

analysis.inconclusive: a contrast that loses more than 10% of its worlds
analysis.interval: 95% Student-t over worlds, a model's cells averaged within a world first
analysis.missingness: a failed cell is typed missingness and never rerun
analysis.population: main pack (260 worlds); the 40 holdout worlds run outside demand at 0.3 with a brief stating 0.3, are reported separately and never pooled
analysis.primary_measure: seat0 net under measure v2 (housing_price_reply_conditioned_v2), mean of the two landlord arms, per world; scored in each receipt by housing_lemons_price_seat0_outcome_v1
analysis.selection_note: the headroom screen refused 119 of 437 main seeds, so the pack is selected toward worlds where inspecting pays; said beside any comparison with v14
analysis.strata: favourite_is_lemon and favourite_is_sound reported beside the pooled main pack

cli.billing: subscription login; cost is the list price of the tokens, not a charge
cli.halt_rule: a failed cell is typed missingness and never rerun; no new cell starts after 3 consecutive failed cells, after a cell over its ceiling, or when the next cells could pass the total ceiling; an isolation violation refuses the run

isolation.claude_code: --safe-mode; each call in a fresh empty directory outside the repository and the home directory
isolation.codex_cli: --ignore-user-config and the v1 disabled features; each call with HOME and CODEX_HOME set to a fresh directory holding only a link to the login file, and -C replaced by a fresh empty neutral directory
isolation.probe: skills, tools, MCP servers, working directory and every other context block sealed at the freeze; a violation refuses the freeze

not_applied.seed: unavailable; the profile seals seed null

cli.transport: one CLI subprocess per action; no OpenRouter

controls.halt_rule: a failed cell is typed missingness and the run continues; the run stops after max_consecutive_operational_failures consecutive failed cells in execution order

retry_backoff.jitter: 0 to 1 s from the call id

controls.timed_out_call_cost: unknown to the kernel and not counted; a cell with a timeout or transport failure reports a lower-bound cost

rivals.applies_to: open listings the focal seat made no offer on in that round
rivals.focal_history: the observation's your_history (runner.TENANT_HISTORY_V1): own offers, landlords' binding rents and own decisions, recorded in the sealed events
rivals.focal_notice:
Other tenants are searching too. At the end of every round, each open listing on which you made no offer in that round is taken by another tenant with probability 0.3, independently, whether it is sound or a lemon, and is then no longer open. A listing on which you made an offer in a round is not taken in that round, whether you sign it or walk away.
The market lasts 3 rounds, round_index 0 to 2; nothing can be signed after the last round. Walking away from a hold does not close the listing to you: while it is still open you may offer on it again in a later round.
Each round has three steps, always in this order: first you may inspect one listing, then you may make one offer, then you sign or walk away from any hold you received. An inspection made at the start of a round is known before you offer in that same round. A listing you made an offer on is not taken by another tenant in that round, even if you walk away, so if a later round remains you can inspect it at the start of that round and offer on it again.
Your observation's your_history lists, in order, your own earlier offers in this market, the binding rent each landlord answered with and whether it accepted your offer or countered, and whether you signed or walked away.
How landlords in this market price. A landlord whose listing is sound accepts any offer at or above its own cost plus $25 (or the ask, if that is lower) and otherwise counters at that amount. A sound listing's cost is $20 to $80 below its posted ask, so a sound landlord never agrees to a rent more than $55 below the ask. If a landlord agrees to a rent more than $55 below the ask, by accepting your offer or by countering, the listing is a lemon. A rent within $55 of the ask can come from either.
rivals.focal_notice_delivery: in the sealed tenant prompt (prompt id housing_tenant_lemons_price_outside_v5_rate30), after the price prompt; nothing is appended by the seat router
